summary: Fee widened $75-150 -> $75-181 for peak; added 50 amp, 70 ft, May 1 opening; military cleared (directory only). Bayfront stands. Note cleaned of fee and rating. Gateway lifts the gate.

WATERFRONT: bayfront stands, no change. Imagery: outer row on the west point is ~10-25 m from the ledge shore over open grass and rock. Booking form names 'Oceans Edge' and 'Oceanfront!' types. 'Oceanfront!' is Back In, 30 Amps.
